title: Mushroom Burrito
description: Mushroom Burritos are packed with sautéed mixed mushrooms, vegetables, warm spices, and fresh herbs, then wrapped in soft flour tortillas. Finished with avocado, salsa, and a lightly toasted exterior, they make a hearty vegetarian Mexican meal.

ingredients.title: For the Burrito Filling
items: Mixed mushrooms (cremini, shiitake, oyster), sliced – 500 g
Chili powder – ½ tsp (adjust to taste)

ingredients.title: For the Burrito Wrap
items: Sour cream or crema – for drizzling
Salsa verde or roja – for serving

instruction.title: Step 1 – Sauté the Vegetables
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic; sauté until translucent (2–3 min).
Add bell pepper, zucchini, and mushrooms; cook until mushrooms release moisture and it evaporates, about 7–8 min.
Season with smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Stir well.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Finish the Filling
steps: Stir in lime juice and chopped cilantro.
If using, fold in black beans and corn at this stage.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Burrito
steps: Warm tortillas lightly in a skillet or oven.
Place a generous amount of mushroom mixture in the center.
Add shredded cheese if using, avocado slices, and a drizzle of sour cream.
Fold sides over the filling and roll tightly into a burrito.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Optional Pan-Seared Finish
steps: Heat a dry skillet over medium heat and lightly toast each burrito, seam side down, for 1–2 minutes per side for a crispy, restaurant-style finish.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Serve
steps: Serve with salsa verde or roja on the side, with extra cilantro and lime wedges for garnish.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with salsa verde or roja, guacamole, and sour cream.
Pair with Mexican rice, black beans, or a fresh salad.
Garnish with extra cilantro and lime wedges.

chefTips: Use a mix of mushrooms for depth of flavor.
Roast or sauté vegetables at high heat to get caramelization.
Fresh lime juice and cilantro at the end brighten the dish.
Toasting the burrito adds a professional touch and texture.
